description.narrative: Comoros, Malaria, Ministry of Health and Social Protection of the Union of the Comoros (PNLP)This program has the following goals: Reduce transmission to zero cases of indigenous malaria in the Union of Comoros by 2021. The objectives of this program are: Ensure efficient management of the malaria program at all levels, so that at least 80% of the activities of the Strategic Plan for elimination are achieved by 2021. Strengthen surveillance (epidemiological and entomological) and monitoring and evaluation to bring all districts to 100% completeness and timeliness for key indicators of malaria elimination by 2021. Ensure correct management of 100% of malaria cases in health facilities. Ensure coverage of at least 90% of the target population with malaria prevention interventions by 2021. Ensure 100% of the population has the right knowledge, attitudes and practices for malaria elimination by 2021
